symptom: Verify the dashboard: the Carrier performance card is missing. There is no error message and the layout just has a gap where it should be.

truth.cause: Polar Freight has no shipments, so the API returns onTimeRate and averageTransitDays as null. CarrierPerformanceCard calls toFixed on them through non-null assertions and throws, and WidgetBoundary renders its fallback, which defaults to null, so the error is swallowed.

referenceFix.replace:
import { ErrorPanel } from '../../components/ui/feedback'
import { track } from '../../lib/telemetry'
